title: coronilla minima subsp. lotoides
intro: Coronilla minima subsp. lotoides, commonly known as Lesser Coronilla, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Lesser Coronilla include its ability to act as a diuretic, reducing water retention and alleviating symptoms of urinary tract issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavonoids and other flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
